summary.text: Mary Ann Dunwell is a Democratic state senator who represents Montana State Senate District 42, took office in January 2023 after serving in the Montana House from 2015 to 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Mary Ann Dunwell represented Montana House District 84 from 2015 to 2023 before moving to the State Senate, where she assumed office on January 2, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she was vice chair of the Highways and Transportation Committee and a member of the Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation and Senate Taxation committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Stephen LaPraim in the general election.
